title: plugin-form test flake: masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071 case 1 reads the captured grid before it exists
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found on 2026-11-22 by two seat 7 threads: on PR #36437 (Test UI shard 12/16, job 137238402480) and on PR #36438 (Test UI shard 2/16, the same case red on its re-run too). Neither PR touches plugin-form. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`, case 1 ("each member is its own section, in AUTHORED order…"), fails intermittently with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'field')` at the `gridOf('Lines').field` read (around line 259). The case waits for the section headings, then reads `gridOf('Lines')` straight away, before the grid's props have been captured. Cases 2 and 2b in the same file wrap their `gridOf` reads in `waitFor`, and they do not flake.

The #36437 thread measured it locally: 2 of 3 runs failed at that PR's head, it also failed on the merge base `85a995452`, and it passed once on `origin/main` `c9b0a2305`. So the race is on main, not in either PR.

## What should happen

Case 1 waits for the grid capture the same way cases 2 and 2b do, so it passes on every run.

## Done when

- Case 1 reads `gridOf('Lines')` and `gridOf('Line Items')` inside a `waitFor` (or after waiting on the captured grid props), the same pattern as cases 2 and 2b.
- The file passes 20 runs in a row locally (`vitest run --repeat` or a loop), with the run count in the PR body.
- The sibling `*Members-8071` files in the same folder are checked for the same read-after-headings pattern, and any that have it are fixed in the same PR.
